goal: After recur init records directory separators, bare recur tree main from the project root combines configured source and documentation lanes into one hierarchy without explicit --sep flags.
invariants: Core tree queries remain read-only: no config, source, receipt or Eventness mutation.
Explicit --sep options override automatic configured-lane interpretation.
Each file uses its most specific configured directory separator; root queries do not apply every separator indiscriminately to every file.
Unconfigured files retain the dot-separator fallback and projects without config retain existing behavior.
Output preserves actual source paths while merging logical hierarchy segments across lanes.
A failing baseline test demonstrates the gap; it does not prove the fix or satisfy final acceptance.

final_state.description: An initialized mixed-separator project supports bare recur tree main from its root: main_command_watch_impl.rs and main.command.watch.readme.md appear together under main.command.watch as impl and readme, with their real paths preserved.
required_observations: recur init records src separator _ and docs separator .
Bare root tree includes both the source implementation and documentation without --sep.
Nested lane overrides are honored without duplicate or misinterpreted entries.
Explicit separator overrides, subtree queries and no-config queries preserve their documented behavior.
Tree queries leave the complete project file inventory and bytes unchanged.
Focused acceptance and existing relevant hierarchy/separator regressions pass; docs describe root-wide configured behavior.
